items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: You know your friend... That Faye's a wonderful gal. She's highly country. She brought me right along, that music deal.

ctx.x: You know your friend, the drummer that comes to see you all the time. Yeah. The trumpet player and the two boys that just play in your band. Yeah. And you haven't told him about your big band here nor showing him the picture of it. Well we'll get to that in a minute. Well we'll get to that in a minute. Well we'll get to that in a minute. Well we'll see.

We'll see. We'll see. About stuff I didn't know, I thought she was from Denver. Anyway, she's on the directing board. I saw her. And now I'm from Dallas. Yeah. That Faye's a wonderful gal. She's highly country. She brought me right along, that music deal.
How long did you live down in Los Angeles then? From 1915, you say you moved out about.
